techniques.name: MolCrystalFlow
techniques.subfield: A: flow matching for molecular crystal structure prediction
techniques.capability_enabled: Predicts molecular crystal structures by embedding molecules as rigid bodies and jointly learning the lattice matrix, molecular orientations and centroid positions on their native Riemannian manifolds via geodesic flow matching.
techniques.code_evidence: GitHub repository visible in search results: github.com/Liu-Group-UF/MolCrystalFlow ('Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction with Flow Matching').
techniques.verbatim_quote: The framework disentangles intramolecular complexity from intermolecular packing by embedding molecules as rigid bodies and jointly learning the lattice matrix, molecular orientations, and centroid positions.

techniques.name: EnFlow (Energy-Guided Flow Matching)
techniques.subfield: A: flow matching for molecular conformer generation / ground-state identification
techniques.capability_enabled: Couples flow matching with an explicitly learned energy model via energy-guided sampling to produce high-fidelity molecular conformers and identify ground states in just 1-2 ODE steps.
techniques.code_evidence: Official code repository stated in search result: https://github.com/Rich-XGK/EnFlow.git
techniques.verbatim_quote: By incorporating energy-gradient guidance during sampling, this method steers trajectories toward lower-energy regions, substantially improving conformational fidelity, particularly in the few-step regime.

techniques.name: SymTorch
techniques.subfield: B: symbolic regression / symbolic distillation of neural networks
techniques.capability_enabled: Wraps neural-network components (GNNs, PINNs, transformers), collects their input-output behavior, and replaces them with human-readable closed-form equations via PySR, enabling interpretability of trained models.
techniques.code_evidence: GitHub repo github.com/astroautomata/SymTorch plus ReadTheDocs documentation (symtorch.readthedocs.io) visible in search results.
techniques.verbatim_quote: SymTorch automates distillation by wrapping neural network components, collecting their input-output behavior, and approximating them with human-readable equations via PySR, while handling engineering challenges including GPU-CPU data transfer, input-output caching, model serialization, and seamless switching between neural and symbolic forward passes.

techniques.name: OrgFlow
techniques.subfield: A: flow matching for organic crystal structure generation from molecular graphs
techniques.capability_enabled: Generates organic crystal structures directly from the asymmetric-unit molecular graph, integrating molecular connectivity with periodic boundary conditions and using a bond-aware Student-t regularizer for realistic covalent geometry.
techniques.code_evidence: No code/weights link found. Search results reference a flow-matching paper tracker only; a targeted code search returned an unrelated Salesforce 'OrgFlow' DevOps tool, not the crystal model. No explicit release statement seen.
techniques.verbatim_quote: OrgFlow is the first flow-matching framework that (i) conditions explicitly on the asymmetric-unit molecular graph, (ii) trains on a large organic-only corpus with molecule-disjoint splits, and (iii) introduces a bond-aware Student-t regularizer tailored to organic covalent geometry.

techniques.name: SGN (Symbolic Graph Networks for PDE Discovery)
techniques.subfield: B: equation discovery / symbolic regression for PDEs from noisy sparse data
techniques.capability_enabled: Discovers governing PDEs from noisy, sparse data by using graph message passing for a non-local representation (robust to high-frequency noise) and a symbolic regression module to extract interpretable equations.
techniques.code_evidence: One early WebSearch result block claimed code at github.com/CXY0112/SGN, but a follow-up targeted search could NOT confirm that repository exists. Treating as unverified; marking false to stay honest.
techniques.verbatim_quote: Instead of relying on local differential approximations, SGN leverages graph message passing to model spatial interactions, providing a non-local representation that is less sensitive to high-frequency noise.

techniques.name: PuckerFlow
techniques.subfield: A: flow matching for cyclic/ring conformer generation
techniques.capability_enabled: Generates conformers of cyclic (ring) structures by performing flow matching in low-dimensional Cremer-Pople ring-puckering coordinates, outperforming prior conformer generators on most metrics for drug-discovery and catalysis ring systems.
techniques.code_evidence: No official code repository found despite targeted searches; only an external flow-matching paper tracker references the arXiv ID. No release statement seen.
techniques.verbatim_quote: PuckerFlow is a generative machine learning model that performs flow matching on the Cremer-Pople space, a low-dimensional internal coordinate system capturing the relevant degrees of freedom of rings.
